title: Tokyo markets closed — Vernal Equinox (Mar. 21) observed; the only March 2027 JPX holiday
source: NEWS: jpx.co.jp/english/corporate/about-jpx/calendar/ ('Market Holidays', page's own 'Update : Feb. 06, 2026'), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 33,103 bytes) and parsed date-by-date out of its 2027 panel by this session. The panel states 'JPX markets are closed on Saturdays, Sundays, national holidays, and on the dates indicated below' and lists for 2027, in order: Jan. 1 (Fri.) New Year's Day; Jan. 2 (Sat.); Jan. 3 (Sun.); Jan. 11 (Mon.) Coming of Age Day; Feb. 11 (Thu.) National Foundation Day; Feb. 23 (Tue.) Emperor's Birthday; Mar. 21 (Sun.) Vernal Equinox; **Mar. 22 (Mon.) Vernal Equinox (Mar. 21) observed**; Apr. 29 (Thu.) Showa Day; May 3-5; Jul. 19; Aug. 11; Sep. 20; Sep. 23; Oct. 11; Nov. 3; Nov. 23; Dec. 31. Mar. 22 is the ONLY March 2027 entry, so Tokyo trades every other March session including Good Friday. The page's own note explains the substitution rule verbatim: 'National holidays that fall on a Sunday are observed on the closest following day that is not a national holiday.' Filed estimate on three counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:) has no slot for a securities exchange's own holiday calendar, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and JPX's own note warns 'Exchange holidays are subject to change due to changes to national holidays under Japan's Act on National Holidays'. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence
notes: DISCOVERED during the boj-minutes-2027-03-24 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05). FIRST NON-US EXCHANGE CLOSURE ON THIS CALENDAR — the two closure entries that precede it (good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15) are both NYSE. WHY IT EARNS A SLOT: it is the D-2 of boj-minutes-2027-03-24 and it decides which instrument that event can be read on. Tokyo's week of 2027-03-22 starts on TUESDAY 03-23, so the 03-23 Nikkei bar absorbs a three-day gap of US news — the 2027-03-17 FOMC aftermath and the 2027-03-19 quarterly triple witching (opex-2027-03-19, high) — while WEDNESDAY 03-24, the BoJ Minutes session, is an ordinary second session with nothing Japanese ahead of it and the 08:50 JST release landing ten minutes before the 09:00 JST cash open. The US 03-24 bar has no equivalent cleanliness (it sits mid-week between triple witching and Good Friday), which is why the boj-minutes-2027-03-24 ledger leans on the Nikkei bar for attribution. THE SAME FACT MATTERS ONE WEEK LATER IN THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION: Japan does not observe Good Friday, so Tokyo trades 2027-03-26 and 2027-03-29 as ordinary sessions while the NYSE is shut 03-26 — the four-day US gap around Easter 2027 is American only, a point the boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29 ledger established from this same JPX page and could not file as an entry because 03-22 sits outside ITS adjacency window. IMPACT IS LOW and structural only: a day one exchange is shut moves nothing by itself, no house playbook is calendar-keyed, and symbols is empty. It changes how many sessions the surrounding flows clear in and which close-to-close bar is uncontaminated, never direction. HONEST LIMIT ON THE KIND FIELD: EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no slot for an exchange-schedule event, so this is filed 'sector', the same least-wrong choice good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 documented; that entry already banks the open question of whether the union needs a 'market-structure' member, and this is a second data point for it rather than a new ask.
